Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: mlx-local-inference
Version: 2.2.1

The skill bundle provides legitimate instructions and code snippets for running local AI inference on Apple Silicon using the MLX framework and the oMLX gateway. It utilizes the 'uv' package manager for handling dependencies (mlx-lm, mlx-vlm, mlx-audio) and interacts with a local API at localhost:8000, with no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or unauthorized persistence mechanisms.
